name: Stitches
summary: Along Duskwood's western road, Stitches marches east toward Darkshire, crushing the Night Watch and unwary travelers in his path.

sections.title: The Terror of the Main Road
sections.body: Near Abercrombie's shack, northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, Stitches sets out east along the road to Darkshire. Unholy sorcery and harvested corpses have made him an undead abomination. His immense strength and malice overwhelm the Night Watch checkpoints. Across from Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and outside the Rotting Orchard, he tears through the defense camp and outpost, slaughtering travelers and town defenders as he goes.

sections.title: The Embalmer's Twisted Revenge
sections.body: Abercrombie, whom passersby know as a harmless hermit, bears a deep grudge against Lord Ello Ebonlocke, Darkshire's mayor. Under innocent guises, he relied on unsuspecting adventurers to gather occult reagents, tools, and materials. Then Abercrombie completed his horrific creation and sent Stitches to Darkshire as a mocking gift. He means to break the town's defenses and punish Lord Ebonlocke.

faq.answer: Stitches was assembled in Duskwood through necromancy. Who made him remains part of the mystery surrounding the undead near Raven Hill.

faq.q: Why is Stitches marching toward Darkshire?
faq.answer: Stitches marches along Duskwood's main road toward Darkshire, attacking the Night Watch and anyone else in his path. The reason for his attack emerges during the local investigation.

faq.q: Can the Night Watch stop Stitches on their own?
faq.answer: No. Stitches easily overwhelms the Night Watch checkpoints outside Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the Rotting Orchard. He can reach Darkshire's gates unless the militia joins forces with traveling adventurers to bring him down.
Stitches appears behind Abercrombie's shack, along the road northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery. Then he begins his long, deadly march east across Duskwood.

angles.text: Stitches threatens Darkshire's beleaguered citizens and makes Duskwood's high road a deadly gauntlet for fresh Alliance recruits.
As a grotesque product of necromancy and profane flesh-crafting, Stitches embodies what the Holy Light is called upon to purge.
